title: Following the Orbax V1 migration in cl/974668260, MaxText temporarily attached its Goodput `CloudLogger` via private Orbax internals (`_manager._logger`) and wrapped `load_checkpointables()` in a helper to manually time and emit `RestoreStepStatistics` (cl/995181750). Now that `orbax.checkpoint.v1.training.Checkpointer` natively accepts a `logger` argument and emits `RestoreStepStatistics` from `load_checkpointables()` (cl/998371284), those private workarounds are no longer needed.
